# Solar Energy Enterprises

> Solar Energy Enterprises is a government-approved solar company in Bikaner, Rajasthan, India, delivering domestic and commercial solar power since 2018. Founder: Rishab Purohit. Co-Founder: Anurag Purohit. CEO: Manoj Kumar. Over 200 projects delivered. Registered under MSME and Udyam, approved by State and Central Government, and a registered vendor under the PM Surya Ghar rooftop-solar subsidy scheme.

## What we do
- Residential rooftop solar: 3 KW to 20 KW, starting from Rs 1.80 Lakh, with up to Rs 78,000 PM Surya Ghar subsidy handled end to end.
- Commercial and industrial solar: 5 KW to 200 KW, starting from Rs 3.50 Lakh, for offices, showrooms, hotels and factories.
- Full service: free consultation, site survey, system design, certified installation, net metering, DISCOM and subsidy paperwork, and 6 months of on-site support after installation.
- Typical outcome: electricity bills reduced by up to 90%; panels built to last 25 years.
- Enterprise solar EPC: turnkey engineering, procurement and construction for ground-mount and
  utility-scale plants, government and semi-government tenders, PSUs, power developers and large
  industrial clients. Bids independently and also works as an EPC execution partner. Priced per
  project after site assessment. Enquiries: https://solarenergyenterprise.com/enterprise.html

## Registrations and licences
- A-Grade Electrical Contractor
- PWD (Electrical) registered contractor
- RRECL empanelled (Rajasthan Renewable Energy Corporation Ltd)
- PM-KUSUM eligible vendor, from 1 MW
- PM Surya Ghar empanelled vendor
- MSME / Udyam registered
- GSTIN 08AFHFS4941J1ZK
- In-house engineering team (B.Tech, M.Tech and Diploma, Electrical and Renewable Energy) with an
  execution workforce of 85 or more. EMD and bank-guarantee capacity available for eligible tenders.

## Service area
Bikaner and the wider Rajasthan region, including Nagaur, Churu, Sri Ganganagar and Jodhpur.
Pan-India for EPC and tender projects.
